chapter: Chapter One — The Signal That Returned

stages.title: First Light
stages.brief: Move through Lumen Yard and scan the broken welcome relay.

stages.title: An Unfinished Need
stages.brief: Choose which Circuitseed to help first. It joins by consent and repair, never capture.

stages.title: The Relayborn Route
stages.brief: Recover two conductive filaments and patch the route beacon after diagnosis.

stages.title: Threads Remember
stages.brief: Map three honest signal knots in the Threadwild. Uncertain readings count when labeled.

stages.title: Contain, Do Not Conquer
stages.brief: Stabilize the Corewild breach through tactical containment and recovery.

stages.title: A Useful Place
stages.brief: Craft a service kit and choose a business path at your personal workbench.

stages.title: The First Honest Order
stages.brief: Open the stall and fulfill one demand-backed local order.

stages.title: What We Changed
stages.brief: Resolve the world-state request created by the region with the highest unresolved instability.

stages.title: Shared Pulse
stages.brief: Synchronize the relay with another occupied seat, or with your trusted Circuitkin when playing solo.

stages.title: The Rootsignal Fracture
stages.brief: Reach the convergence, surface the conflicting histories, stabilize the fracture, and return to Lumen Yard.
